scene: You step into neon-lit Arcade Alley from the sleek monorail.
picture: Pixel art street view. The player stands centre with a cane, blue cap, and orange cardigan. On the left, the silver monorail doors stay open. Far left sits a glowing claw machine. To the player's right is a ticket counter with a robot clerk. Far right is a flashing beaded doorway.
shown: a glowing glass claw crane filled with plush pixel cats on the far left
a robotic cashier wearing an apron behind a ticket counter on the right
an open beaded curtain doorway flashing with colourful strobes on the far right

variants.scene: The monorail doors slide open to cheerful bleeps, glowing lanterns, and arcade games.
You tap your cane onto the platform while humming {tune} above the noise.
Bright neon signs buzz warmly across the busy station platform tonight.
